name: STRUKT
summary: Technical, spec-sheet construction site: 10px-inset dusk hero, tight Switzer headlines with grey second halves, IBM Plex Mono labels, a red accent used only in tiny doses and a ruler tick motif.

fonts.pairing: Switzer 500 with very tight tracking for display, Inter for reading text, IBM Plex Mono 500 uppercase for labels, buttons and giant numerals

signature: two-tone headlines: first clause in ink or white, second clause in grey, at -0.05em tracking
ruler tick strip along the hero bottom edge and mono spec rows (est., projects, sq ft, certification) like a drawing title block
giant mono numerals with a red unit or percent sign
imagery: dusk cranes and glass towers, aerial site shots, hard-hat crews in orange PPE, crisp finished villas and concrete
layout_grid: 1280px canvas, 10px outer frame on hero, 26px side padding, 140px section padding, 4-column service cards, 10px image radii, 4 to 6px button radii
